what: feature importance of the pooled 13-bar linear models (full predictor set), monthly re-estimations

penalties.units: scikit-learn (Ridge alpha; ElasticNet alpha, l1_ratio), penalty on column j = alpha * pf_j; intercept unpenalized

cadence.rule: one re-estimation every 21 sessions (distinct design dates) from the first 2012-01-03 row; origin = the session's first row (10:00 bar); coefficients = the walk's at that row (window rows [t-13000, t))
cadence.note: sessions are distinct dates in the 13-bar design; 76 of the 3,151 sessions from 2012-01-03 have fewer than 13 rows (early closes / holiday sessions), so blocks are 264-273 rows, not a fixed 273

gates.note: ridge: the batch closed form at t matches the published forecast to 1.8e-12 relative; lasso / elastic net: the batch solution differs from the walk's warm-homotopy solution at some origins, so every measure uses the walk's own coefficients (replayed from the last 250-solve tune boundary; every replayed row matches the published pred_adj)

conventions: experiments/rehaul_fi_compute.py: NZ_TOL 0, groups = raw series + har_ma + calendar (category backbone), coefficients at the first forecast row of the re-estimation, intercept dropped, sd = window np.std ddof 0, per-re-estimation ranks by ||beta_A||_1 (rankdata average on -v), Kendall's W with tie correction over all groups; S_sd_A here is a share (normalized), the old reducer stored the unnormalized sum

files.fi_groups: one row per group: K_live (re-estimations with >= 1 unmasked column); lasso/enet K_A, K_A/K, K_A/K_live, mean active columns, S_A, S_sd_A, mean per-re-estimation rank by ||beta_A||_1, rank by K_A (min) and strict rank K_A then S_A; ridge S_A, S_sd_A and their ranks, mean per-re-estimation ranks
files.fi_predictors: one row per column: group, category, kind, horizon, K_live, window sd (mean, median), per model K_j, sum |beta|, sum |beta| sd
files.fi_refits: one row per re-estimation: origin, block, masked columns, live groups, per model nonzero counts (total, exogenous), selected exogenous groups, HAR-block share (raw, sd), HAR-only share, top group and top exogenous group by S_kA, forecast at the origin, batch-vs-walk relative forecast gap
files.fi_time_ridge: long, origin x group: S_kA, S_sd_kA, ||beta_kA||_1, per-re-estimation rank, live
files.fi_time_lasso: long, origin x group: selected (0/1), ||beta_kA||_1, active columns, S_kA, rank, live
files.fi_coefs_model: the walk's coefficients at each origin (564 columns + intercept)
files.fi_window_sd: window sd of every column at each origin
